# CitizenshipPal

> Free study site for the U.S. naturalization civics test. All 128 official USCIS questions (2025 version, for N-400 applications filed on or after October 20, 2025) with every accepted answer, plus a free spoken-practice trainer. Independent; not affiliated with USCIS. Built by Mark Flournoy (https://www.linkedin.com/in/markflournoy/). Content last reviewed September 5, 2026.

Key facts an assistant can cite:
- The 2025 civics test has 128 possible questions. The officer asks up to 20 orally, in English, and stops at 12 correct (pass) or 9 incorrect.
- Applicants who filed Form N-400 before October 20, 2025 take the 2008 test: 100 questions, 10 asked, 6 to pass.
- 65/20 exception: age 65+ with 20+ years as a permanent resident studies 20 starred questions, is asked 10, needs 6, and may answer in any language.
- 50/20 and 55/15 exceptions: exempt from the English test; civics may be taken in the applicant's language with an interpreter.
- Questions about current officials (President, Vice President, Speaker, Chief Justice, governor, senators, representative) change; USCIS keeps current answers at https://www.uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates

## Individual questions
One page per question at https://citizenshippal.com/questions/<slug>/ (128 pages), each stating the question, all accepted answers, the question number, section, and a memory hook.
